title: Representative overhead hoist transport: straight ceiling rail, one vehicle with belt hoist and gripper, serving three load ports

source.note: Ceiling rail + vehicle + belt hoist + gripper + FOUP 대표 구조의 일관된 가상 설계값이다. Rail 높이, vehicle 치수, hoist stroke, gripper offset은 가정이며 특정 제조사 제품 규격이 아니다. 하나의 직선 rail, vehicle 1대, Load port 3개만 다룬다.
references: Muratec CFA / OHT: rail vehicle, hoisting, FOUP and load port relation (structure only)
Daifuku Cleanway: FOUP logistics between ceiling rail and process tools (structure only)
SEMI E84 scope: carrier handoff communication (not implemented; scope reference only)

coordinate_system.origin: Fab floor under the rail center line (y = 0); the rail runs along +Z

foup.note: Closed 25-slot FOUP. Origin = bottom seating reference (kinematic coupling center); the wafer stack center sits on the same vertical line; the front door faces +X. Values are design assumptions, not a product drawing.
